notes_for_editor: Status rests on the Forest Service project page (removal decision signed March 5, 2020; listed 'Completed') and the FFLA list ('Gone'). No source gives a demolition date or describes what remains on the summit. The register text (2006) describes the cab in use. The record's kind 'two_story' matches the FFLA label '2-Story Cab'; the register does not use that term and describes a cab on a 10-foot concrete block base. The register's Built field says 1958, but the same entry says a wooden tower was used there in the 1920s, so 1958 is the cab date. The Kaibab project documents (on Box and Pinyon Public) were linked but not readable here. No access, trail, or visit information in any source read.
